summary: Short paved stub beside an unmapped house, apparently its driveway.
reasons: Private-looking driveway, no room to stop

best_section.where: north edge of the stub just above the house

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind, but an unmapped house sits within a few metres of the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow paved stub that looks like the house's driveway; bank and trees on the other side, nowhere to pull clear.
drivers.traffic: Almost none, but a van would block the residents.
drivers.convention: No sign of parking or camping.

flags: Low-lying: min 7.2 m, Witton Creek 27 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy over most of it, shading from the north and south.
